meta.grain: one row per (drug, ATC code, mode of administration)
meta.mode_rule: WHO ATC/DDD AdmR first; a US label route only when AdmR is empty; a DailyMed dosage-form inference only when there is no label route; otherwise the FDA legend's NOT APPLICABLE entry. Every mode is mapped to the FDA route legend, and no route is ever re-mapped onto a different legend route.
meta.smiles_rule: sheet, then drugbank_drugs_info.csv moldb_smiles, then the curated parent in data/drugs.json, then ChEMBL, each validated with RDKit before it is accepted and falling through to the next source when RDKit rejects it. PubChem is never used for SMILES because its SMILES cannot distinguish tautomers or isomers.

reachability.pk_db_outputs: reachable but unusable anonymously: /outputs/ returns count=0 even when the filter reports hundreds, so half-life and bioavailability need credentials this project does not have; dose and dose interval are taken from /interventions/ instead

pk_table_warnings: the lethal doses in this group are not one kind of number: ranitidine's and nizatidine's are intravenous LD50s, famotidine's is an oral LD50 given as a lower bound, and cimetidine has no published LD50 at all, only a two-year no-effect dose. A therapeutic index is only comparable between values of the same kind and the same route, so each row carries both.
